import sys

def main():
    # Read the two lines of input
    line1 = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    line2 = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    # Parse the real and imaginary parts
    real1, imag1 = map(int, line1.split())
    real2, imag2 = map(int, line2.split())
    
    # Addition: (a + bi) + (c + di) = (a + c) + (b + d)i
    add_real = real1 + real2
    add_imag = imag1 + imag2
    
    # Subtraction: (a + bi) - (c + di) = (a - c) + (b - d)i
    sub_real = real1 - real2
    sub_imag = imag1 - imag2
    
    # Multiplication: (a + bi) * (c + di) = (ac - bd) + (ad + bc)i
    mul_real = real1 * real2 - imag1 * imag2
    mul_imag = real1 * imag2 + imag1 * real2
    
    # Division: (a + bi) / (c + di) = [(ac + bd) / (c² + d²)] + [(bc - ad) / (c² + d²)]i
    denom = real2 * real2 + imag2 * imag2
    div_real = (real1 * real2 + imag1 * imag2) / denom
    div_imag = (imag1 * real2 - real1 * imag2) / denom
    
    # Print results formatted to 2 decimal places
    print(f"Addition: {add_real:.2f} + {add_imag:.2f}i")
    print(f"Subtraction: {sub_real:.2f} + {sub_imag:.2f}i")
    print(f"Multiplication: {mul_real:.2f} + {mul_imag:.2f}i")
    
    # Handle division output with proper sign for imaginary part
    sign = '+' if div_imag >= 0 else '-'
    print(f"Division: {div_real:.2f} {sign} {abs(div_imag):.2f}i")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
